messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: `edge-router-latency` — triggered from synthetic canaries in us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1. Severity: P2. Routing to #eng-oncall.

tess: acked — I'm on it.

miguel: seeing a short-lived tail latency spike on the ingress percentiles, synthetic 99.9th jumped to ~2.8s across regions. no 5xxs in app logs so far.

tess: thanks. quick check: can we confirm autoscaler kicked?

miguel: `kubectl get hpa -n ingress` shows desired=3 current=1 in us-west1 for router-pool. autoscale didn't react (minReplicas=1). scaling manually now: `kubectl scale deploy/router-pool --replicas=3 -n ingress`

tess: doing a rolling restart of router pods in us-west1 to clear stuck epoll fds: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/router-pool -n ingress --timeout=2m`

oncall-sre: I'll watch the tail and traces. quick FYI — no customer-facing errors in Sentry or Datadog traces. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by tess.

miguel: metrics trending down after scale / restart — 99.9th back to ~180ms in us-west1 within 40s.

oncall-sre: checked router logs quickly — a small burst of socket backlog + a transient DNS flake to an external monitoring endpoint at the same time, likely correlated. posted logs: ```
[2026-03-17T09:01:23Z] ingress-router-0 - backlog=120 conn_handshake=avg=12ms
[2026-03-17T09:01:24Z] dns-resolve external-monitoring failed, err=timeout
```

sam (service-owner): no customer complaints on support channels. good to know.

miguel: recommend we increase HPA margin for router-pool (minReplicas 2) and add a short cooldown config for the synthetic probe to reduce sensitivity to transient DNS hiccups. will open a PR after this.

tess: handing off monitoring to oncall-sre for 30m. I'm stepping off for a quick breakpoint. :coffee: @oncall-sre please escalate if it reappears.

oncall-sre: taking over — I'll watch dashboards for 30m and will escalate if tail > 1s persists.

incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved (edge-router-latency) — condition returned to normal. PagerDuty incident closed.

miguel: closing thread notes: transient spike, localized to router backlog + external DNS timeout, no customer impact. follow-ups: HPA tweak + probe cooldown PR.

tess: thanks team.
